capabilities: render notes using built-in layout templates
create notes from templates like Cornell and Eisenhower Matrix
embed views from other tabs into notes via code blocks or a command
unlock premium features by logging in with a PKMer account
disambiguation: Not a text-template inserter like core Templates; it renders notes into visual layouts and templates are not yet user-creatable.
extras: The plugin is closed source (though the Obsidian team can review it); some features require a PKMer account login. It is not yet available in the community plugin store and must be installed manually from GitHub releases; a video tutorial is linked externally. Creating custom templates is not yet available.
problem: Obsidian renders notes as plain Markdown, so structured layouts like the Cornell method or a 2x2 Eisenhower Matrix have to be built by hand.
summary: Note layout plugin that renders notes into template-based layouts such as Cornell notes and the Eisenhower Matrix, and can embed other views into notes.
